item.title: State Department reveals world's most dangerous countries for Americans
item.summary: Americans face risks of "arbitrary arrests" and kidnapping abroad amid State Department warnings for the Middle East, Mexico and Iran-linked threats.

item.title: Trump speaks out on Iran's execution of 19-year-old wrestler Saleh Mohammadi
item.summary: President Donald Trump addressed Iran's reported execution of 19-year-old wrestler Saleh Mohammadi, saying he was killed for speaking against the regime.

item.title: President Trump insists MAGA 'loves' his war on Iran: 'MAGA people are smart'
item.summary: President Donald Trump said the MAGA base supports his military campaign on Iran during an interview on "The Five," noting that supporters know he's protecting the United States.

item.title: Trump says Iranian protesters being ‘shot by snipers,’ voices support for people under regime
item.summary: President tells "The Five" the Iranian regime uses snipers to suppress protests, drawing a distinction between Iran's leadership and its people amid Operation Epic Fury.

item.title: Climate executive warns California ‘functionally bankrupt,’ $1T shortfall could shake nation
item.summary: Climate entrepreneur David Friedberg warned California is “functionally bankrupt," citing pension liabilities, legal limits, and spending concerns in a recent interview.

item.title: Taylor Swift stuns at iHeartRadio Music Awards; Jason and Brittany Aldean turn heads during date night
item.summary: Stars like Taylor Swift, Jason Aldean, Donnie Wahlberg and Jenny McCarthy lit up the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards red carpet at the Dolby Theater in style.

item.title: Bars could stay open until near dawn in key state for America 250 as 'noise' warnings surface
item.summary: Philadelphia bars could serve alcohol until 4 a.m. under a new $500 permit tied to the FIFA World Cup this summer. It's expected to bring in $770 million to Pennsylvania.

item.title: Doctor’s bloodied wife seen in bodycam after screaming for help from husband’s alleged attack
item.summary: Bodycam footage shown at an attempted murder trial in Maui captured Arielle Konig bloodied on a trail. Prosecutors allege her doctor husband attacked her.

item.title: Schumer, Dems block DHS funding again as Trump intervenes to pay TSA agents
item.summary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D., said bipartisan DHS shutdown talks are progressing after Republicans sent Democrats what he called a "last and final" funding offer.

item.title: United jet dodges Black Hawk in last-second maneuver over California airport: 'That was not good'
item.summary: The FAA is investigating a close call between a United Airlines Boeing 737 and a Black Hawk helicopter at John Wayne Airport in Santa Ana, California.
